events.title: Skyward Ruins
events.message:
Eight districts. One summit.

Pale ledges give way under the pot. Wind rings launch you. The hammer can fend off the watchkeepers. Broad landings are resting places, not checkpoints.

events.title: Tilted Quarry
events.message: Work with the slopes. The side wind platforms are shortcuts, not the only way up.

events.title: Bell Spires
events.message: Rounded stone rewards a planted hammer. Take the broad landings when you need to reset your grip.

events.title: The Unraveling
events.message: Pale stone holds the hammer, but not the pot for long. The darker route remains after it disappears.

events.title: Wind Galleries
events.message: A higher lift needs room for the hammer. The outside shafts lead back to broad landing lips.

events.title: Prism Teeth
events.message: The guards can be outmaneuvered or struck. The last stretch rewards control more than speed.

events.title: Above the weather
events.message:
600 metres, one continuous climb.

Your time is stopped. The ruins below are still there; the summit is yours.
